_desc: Regression guard for the beacon-anchored gateway-schedule countdown (PROTOCOL: schedule records 'anchored to the BCN receive time'). With node_startup_jitter_ms>0, gw_4 boots at a jittered offset, so its L5 visit windows are phase-shifted off the wall clock. Each gw_4 home beacon advertises a LIVE countdown (byte 2 of the schedule record) to its next L5 visit; l4_sender anchors that to its own BCN-receive time and so predicts the away windows correctly despite the boot jitter. l4_sender sends two cross-layer DMs to l5_target (key 0xCAFE0000, a direct L5 neighbour of gw_4 whose binding gw_4 already learned 1-hop, so NO 'H' flood is needed -- this isolates the schedule defer). When a send's RTS to gw_4 would land in gw_4's L5 window, l4_sender emits tx_gateway_schedule_defer (next_hop=10) and waits for the home window instead of RTSing into the void; both DMs are delivered. Before the fix (wall-clock-anchored prediction) the boot jitter desynced the prediction and l4_sender RTSed during the real away window -> cts_timeout. Sends fire at 50 s and 80 s, after schedules have propagated; run is 120 s for retry headroom.
